title: Sloth waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='60' width='90' height='9' rx='4' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='5' y='60' width='90' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#B07B52'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#A98B6F'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#C9AE90'/>
  <!-- left arm gripping branch -->
  <path d='M34 42 Q24 34 20 50 Q18 58 24 62' stroke='#A98B6F' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='62' r='5' fill='#8E7257'/>
  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <path d='M66 42 Q78 30 84 18' stroke='#A98B6F' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='16' r='6' fill='#8E7257'/>
  <!-- claws on wave -->
  <circle cx='81' cy='11' r='2' fill='#E8DCC8'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='10' r='2' fill='#E8DCC8'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='13' r='2' fill='#E8DCC8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='17' fill='#BFA386'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#EADFCB'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='31' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#6B4E3D'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='31' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#6B4E3D'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='30' r='2.4' fill='#2E1F17'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='30' r='2.4' fill='#2E1F17'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='29' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='29' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='3' ry='2.4' fill='#4A3327'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 42 Q50 46 55 42' stroke='#4A3327' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='24' r='3' fill='#8E7257'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='24' r='3' fill='#8E7257'/>
  <!-- feet on branch -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='66' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8E7257'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='66' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8E7257'/>
  <!-- wave lines -->
  <path d='M92 12 Q96 16 92 20' stroke='#FFD27A' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M94 26 Q98 29 95 33' stroke='#FFD27A' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
